question: How do iPhone 11 owners describe both the camera quality and battery life?
answer:
One reviewer said the iPhone 11 has a good camera but that the battery is a little low, calling battery life the only real problem. [e798a484e5ab_0]
Another reviewer said the phone works great and battery life could be better but is good for the price, noting minor scratches on the edge of the camera. [d1ce410afbb8_0]
One reviewer said the battery life is amazing and lasts a whole day, and also likes the camera quality. [8d31c5076b4f_0]
Another reviewer said battery life is good and camera quality is great. [80dbc0343fc0_0]
One reviewer was disappointed with short battery life, saying their iPhone 6S Pro still has better battery life than this newer phone. [7fc4fcbb2941_0]
Other reviewers were impressed with both battery life and camera quality, with one calling the picture quality excellent and another saying the battery life is amazing and the camera is great. [733173e34082_0] [5525512a1c15_0] [1bb07b6c34e4_0]

chunks.text: Good camera, but battery is a little low. Delivery was prompt, phone is clear and scratch free. Camera looks good. Packaging was nice. Only real problem is the battery life. The battery was "guaranteed" to be 90% or more, and on purchase it was 89%. Come on!

Battery life was at 83%. The phone works great. Minor scratches on the edge of the camera. Battery life could be better but for the price it's good. A charger was provided but no SIM card ejector tool was included which is fine since I have plenty of them. The phone came with a screen protector pre installed.
iPhone. The battery life is amazing it last me a whole day, it took me awhile to get use to not having a home button but one thing i do like is the camera quality
Everything I was expecting. Battery life is good. Didn’t come damaged or cracked. Camera quality is great

Short battery life from seller. Expected better than 82% battery life from a “excellent” quality phone. My iPhone 6S Pro still has better battery life now than this newer phone. The phone itself is fine, just not fond of received battery life on phone.

Good purchase overall. The one came in and it worked so that was good off the bat. There were a few scratches on the back and around the outside of the camera. The only thing I was disappointed in is the battery life is 81%, I know they are renewed but that definitely could be better
Impressed. Especially grateful for battery life and the camera quality. Very favorably impressed
Great purchase. I love the sharpness of the face recognition and the battery life is really good. I charge my iPhone in the night and it last all day. The picture quality is excellent
Amazing!. I received it a day early actually and it’s been working so good! No problems at all. Battery life is amazing and the camera is great!

Battery Guarantee is False. The phone works, but when you make a guarantee that the battery life should be 90% or better and you charge based on that claim the company should make it right. The overall battery health (which apparently went through "quality check") was in the 80s and I reached out to customer service to give them a chance to make it right. They did not and I am not satisfied.
